sentences.text: No: the May 7, 2014 circular on levy of foreclosure charges/pre-payment penalty on floating rate term loans was withdrawn/repealed with effect from 2026-01-01 and is no longer in force on 2026-11-23.

The in-force UCB directions now contain separate pre-payment charge rules for floating rate loans, including para 260 for existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before 2025-12-31 and para 261 for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 2026-01-01, but the applicable branch cannot be confirmed from the provided purpose and sanction date.
